translation: The revered Jagannath Maharaj built a temple at Falu in Samvat 1956. That temple has since been shifted to New Falu (Nava Falu). Jamnaba, wife of Jagannath, who had come from Puniyad, used to tend to that gadi (seat of succession). After she passed away there, Gangaba, Jagannath's second wife, stayed on for some time to tend to it. After Jagannath's own passing, she returned to Puniyad; thereafter a priest (pujari) was appointed. Today the gadi continues with the cooperation of the village; it is a sacred site.
